idea: Should I leave a stable government job to join a 12-person startup that offered me 30% more pay?
context: I'm 29 with no kids, and rent is a third of my salary. The startup raised a Series A eight months ago.

idea: Should I accept a promotion to team manager even though I enjoy hands-on engineering more?
context: The raise is 15%. My company has no senior individual-contributor track.

idea: Should I go back to university for a master's degree at 34?
context: Fees are $40,000. Job ads in my field (data analysis) increasingly list the degree as preferred, not required.

idea: Should I take a fully remote job that pays 10% less than my current hybrid one?
context: My commute is 75 minutes each way, three days a week.

idea: Should I tell my manager that I am interviewing elsewhere?
context: We get along well. Two colleagues who did this were moved off key projects.

idea: Should I switch careers from nursing to software development through a coding bootcamp?
context: I have 6 years of nursing experience and 8 months of savings. The bootcamp costs $15,000.

idea: Should I accept a counter-offer from my current employer after resigning?
context: They matched the new salary. I resigned because of a difficult manager, who is staying.

idea: Should I move abroad for a two-year contract in Singapore?
context: The pay doubles. My partner would have to leave their job to come with me.

idea: Should I quit my job to work on my SaaS side project full time?
context: It makes $2,000 a month after 14 months. I have 18 months of savings.

idea: Should we accept a $500,000 seed investment at a $3 million valuation?
context: We have $8,000 in monthly revenue. The investor wants a board seat.

idea: Should I bring in my best friend as an equal co-founder?
context: I have built the prototype alone for a year. He has sales experience but has never worked at a startup.

idea: Should we pivot our food-delivery app to office catering for businesses?
context: Consumer growth has stalled at 3% a month. Two companies asked us for catering without being prompted.

idea: Should I open a coffee shop in my small town?
context: The town has 9,000 people and one chain coffee shop. I would need a $120,000 loan.

idea: Should we make our product free to grow faster before charging again?
context: We have 400 paying users at $10 a month and 11 months of runway.

idea: Should I sell my bootstrapped online store for three times its annual profit?
context: Profit is $90,000 a year and growing 20% a year. I am tired of running it.

idea: Should we hire a VP of Sales before we reach product-market fit?
context: We are 6 people with 15 customers, and monthly churn is 8%.

idea: Should we rewrite our Python backend in Rust?
context: p95 latency is 800 ms and profiling shows most of the time is spent in database queries. The team of 5 knows Python.

idea: Should we split our monolith into microservices?
context: We have 3 developers and one deployable app, and we deploy twice a week without incidents.

idea: Should we move from AWS to our own servers to cut costs?
context: Our AWS bill is $40,000 a month. Nobody on the team has run hardware before.

idea: Should we adopt TypeScript in our 200,000-line JavaScript codebase?
context: Production bugs from undefined values are our most common type of incident.

idea: Should we replace our SQL database with MongoDB?
context: Our data is orders, customers and invoices, queried with many joins.

idea: Should we let developers use AI coding assistants on our proprietary code?
context: We are a 40-person fintech company with SOC 2 obligations.

idea: Should we build our own authentication system instead of using a provider?
context: We have 2,000 users and one backend developer.

idea: Should we drop our native mobile apps and ship only a progressive web app?
context: 70% of usage is on mobile. Two developers maintain separate iOS and Android codebases.

idea: Should I buy a house now instead of renting?
context: Mortgage payments would be 40% higher than my rent. I may relocate for work within 3 years.

idea: Should I move back to my hometown to be near my ageing parents?
context: My job allows remote work, but my friends and my partner's family live in the city.

idea: Should I lend my brother $10,000 to start a business?
context: That is half my savings. He has not repaid a smaller loan from two years ago.

idea: Should I get a dog while living in a small apartment?
context: I work from home three days a week. The building allows pets under 15 kg.

idea: Should I pay off my student loans early instead of investing the money?
context: The loan interest rate is 4.5%. I have no emergency fund yet.

idea: Should I take a six-month unpaid sabbatical to travel?
context: My employer guarantees my role when I return. My savings would cover the trip twice over.

idea: Should I sell my car and rely on public transport and cycling?
context: I live in a city centre with good transit. I mostly drive at weekends to visit family 80 km away.

idea: Should I end a five-year friendship that has become one-sided?
context: I start every conversation. We used to be very close.

idea: Should I replace my car with a horse for my daily commute?
context: The commute is 12 km along a busy road. I live in a flat with no garden.

idea: Should I name my startup after my cat?
context: The cat is called Sir Pounce. The startup sells accounting software to small firms.

idea: Should our company hold every meeting standing on one leg so meetings stay short?
context: Our meetings run 30 minutes over on average.

idea: Should I learn to juggle to become a better public speaker?
context: I give a conference talk in three months and get very nervous on stage.

idea: Should I propose to my partner during a skydive?
context: My partner is afraid of heights.

idea: Should I paint my house bright purple so it stands out on the street?
context: I plan to sell the house next year. The street has a homeowners' association.

idea: Should our office replace every chair with an exercise ball?
context: We have 25 employees, several of whom have back problems.

idea: Should I eat the same meal every day to save time on decisions?
context: The meal would be rice, beans and broccoli.
